Yes. Hansen mapped approximately **81.3 hectares** of tree-cover loss within the property in 2021, equivalent to **2.23%** of its area. An additional 37.3 hectares occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares and were not counted as events.

Most of the counted loss—68.1 hectares—was in mapped planted forest. Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish deforestation or its cause; it can include plantation harvesting.
